articles.title: Focus, scale, fund: The AI playbook CPG leaders are missing
articles.summary: Small brands are out-innovating giants, buying patterns are changing, and scale isn’t the shield it used to be. Here’s how AI could help fund the next wave of growth in food and beverage.

articles.title: The State of Grocery Retail Europe: Implications for packaging players
articles.summary: Continued growth pressure on European grocery retailers limits opportunities for packaging players. In this environment, cost competitiveness remains imperative.

articles.title: Asia’s energy reckoning: Securing the energy system to drive growth
articles.summary: Recent disruptions have shone a spotlight on the vulnerabilities of Asia’s energy system. Countries could focus on five priority investment areas to support regional growth and resilience.

articles.title: The UK’s regional talent trap and how it restricts regional growth: UK Productivity Series, part 2
articles.summary: The regional distribution of Britain’s economy traps operational leadership talent in London and the South East and prevents businesses across the country from improving their competitiveness. But actions from business and policymakers could reverse this trend.

articles.title: Federal permitting’s uneven economic impact, and what companies can do about it
articles.summary: Permitting delays ripple unevenly across states depending on their industry mix. Companies with projects in the queue can take steps to manage delays.
